pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal patches with moderate edge smoothness; pixel gradients at boundaries are gradual. Patch area is maximal on the upper flank and decreases in size toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes predominantly show three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section but exhibits increased topological density near the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the visible upper neck mane, creating a finely textured 1D silhouette against the out-of-focus background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A subtle vertical linear indentation is visible on the mid-flank. Darkened, irregular textural spots are present on the white pelage of the hindquarters near the tail base.
